walkthroughs.body_html:
User Centred Design — a core area of Design Technology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

User Centred Design brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with User Centred Design.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is the purpose of a jig in manufacturing?
options: How long the tree took to grow.
To guide a tool and ensure consistent, accurate repeated operations.
To hold the workpiece very tightly so it does not move.
To inspect finished products.
